people.name: Ahimelech
people.line: High Priest at Nob who helped David, killed by Saul

people.name: Ahitub
people.line: Father of Ahimelech, High Priest at Nob killed by Saul

people.name: Eli
people.line: High priest and judge of Israel at Shiloh

people.name: Ichabod
people.line: Son of Phinehas, born when the ark was captured.

people.name: Jonathan
people.line: Eldest son of King Saul and friend of David

people.name: Phinehas
people.line: Wicked son of Eli the priest

people.name: Shiloh
people.line: Israelite sanctuary and assembly point during the judges' period

translations.web: including Ahijah, the son of Ahitub, Ichabod’s brother, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eli, the priest of Yahweh in Shiloh, wearing an ephod. The people didn’t know that Jonathan was gone.
translations.bsb: including Ahijah, who was wearing an ephod. He was the son of Ichabod’s brother Ahitub son of Phinehas, the son of Eli the priest of the LORD in Shiloh. But the troops did not know that Jonathan had left.
translations.kjv: And Ahiah, the son of Ahitub, Ichabod's brother, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eli, the LORD'S priest in Shiloh, wearing an ephod. And the people knew not that Jonathan was gone.
translations.asv: and Ahijah, the son of Ahitub, Ichabod's brother, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eli, the priest of Jehovah in Shiloh, wearing an ephod. And the people knew not that Jonathan was gone.
